observations: Three photos show a stack of white multifunction printers wrapped in clear plastic.
The brand 'RICOH' is visible on the front panel of the top unit in all photos.
The top unit has a paper output tray with a document on it.
A colorful sticker with 'Fancy' and images of cakes and food is attached to the front.
The printers appear to be in a warehouse or storage area with other similar units stacked around.
No model number is visible on the front or top of any unit in the photos.
The top unit has a small red label with 'MP CARDIA' visible on the left side.
The bottom units have white drawers with handles, typical of office equipment.
The plastic wrapping is intact, suggesting the items are new or unused.

claims.claim: The MP C4504ex/MP C6004ex multifunction color systems are ideal for fast-paced...
claims.evidence: The model numbers C4504ex and C6004ex are not visible in any photo. The seller's text claims these models, but no photo confirms it.
No proof of origin or usage history is visible in the photos. The term 'London use' is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printers may not be the claimed models (C4504ex or C6004ex).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the front or top of the unit, preferably with the model number visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic RICOH multifunction printer, not as a specific model, which may be worth less.

risks.risk: The printers may be used or refurbished, not new as implied by the plastic wrapping.
risks.proof: A photo showing the serial number and any wear or damage on the casing, or a video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used or refurbished, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The printers may not be functional or may have missing parts (e.g., toner, drum, paper).
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, and operating the scanner and copier functions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the original packaging.
A clear photo of the model label on the front or top of the unit.
A video showing the printer powering on and printing a test page.
A photo of the serial number and any condition of the casing.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
